title: meta: Add issues and PR templates
body:
In order to help people contribute in a more consistent way, we could implement templates for issue and PR's.

https://github.com/blog/2111-issue-and-pull-request-templates

As for PR I never encoutered PR templates, not sure what fits in it.

Thanks for handling that @vvo 

As a sidenote, for PR it's useful to remind that's it's cool to have a description, screenshot and emojis ;)
